name: motionary
description: Motionary (formerly use-scroll-animate): dependency-free scroll animations + 94 animated Web Components — 214 scroll-reveal presets, card/click/button morphs, physics, page transitions, generative & sound-reactive backgrounds, cursor/gesture effects, themes, micro-interactions, <usa-player>, WebGL. React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular or plain HTML.

scripts.build: npm run clean && PART=code node --max-old-space-size=5120 ./node_modules/rollup/dist/bin/rollup -c rollup.config.mjs && PART=dts SLICE=0/3 node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/rollup/dist/bin/rollup -c rollup.config.mjs && PART=dts SLICE=1/3 node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/rollup/dist/bin/rollup -c rollup.config.mjs && PART=dts SLICE=2/3 node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/rollup/dist/bin/rollup -c rollup.config.mjs && node scripts/gen-manifest.mjs && node scripts/gen-deprecated-types.mjs && node scripts/sourcemap-urls.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:exports

author: HarrisonCN
